title: All In MC: Quest
description: Introduces quests, skills, and progression systems to the AllInMC ecosystem.
body:
## All In MC: Quest

A skill and progression mod for the **All In MC** modpack. Level up five distinct skills through natural gameplay — no grind menus, just play.

### Skills

| Skill | How to level |
|---|---|
| ⚔️ Combat | Hit hostile mobs |
| ⛏️ Mining | Break stone and ore blocks |
| 🪓 Woodcutting | Chop logs |
| 🌾 Farming | Harvest mature crops |
| 💚 Healing | Heal yourself |

Each skill has its own XP track (separate from vanilla XP), a max level of 50, and a scaling XP curve. Your skill data persists through death.

### Controls

Press **J** (rebindable) to open the Skills menu and check your progress.

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.4
- NeoForge 21.4.156+
- [All In MC: Configs]([link](https://modrinth.com/mod/allinmc-configs)) 0.1.0+

### Part of All In MC

This mod is part of the **All In MC** modpack by Sqersters. It works alongside other All In MC modules like Multiminer and Configs.
